'''Kaminoan Weaponsmiths''' was a company based on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. A subsidiary of [[Kaminoan Armorsmiths Ltd./Legends|Kaminoan Armorsmiths Ltd.]], they produced small weapons that were handmade and produced in small numbers by trained craftsmen. Producing high-quality products such as the [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|Mk I Saberdart]], the Weaponsmiths were relatively unknown outside of small [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] leagues.<ref name="EV" />
